facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.compute_molecular_regularization: compute per-system regularization energy by scattering bond constraints across batched molecular graphs
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.refactor_regularizer_to_huber_loss: refactor bond_structure_regularizer to use huber_loss instead of relu for smoother constraint penalties
